# Chemical components for tests

Five components of the wwPDB's Chemical Component Dictionary, as its archive
gives them, kept unchanged as known answers for `lib/chem/ccd`,
`lib/chem/ccdHydrogens` and `lib/chem/protonation` (their tests:
`ccdComponents.test.ts`).

| File | Component | Source |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ACT.cif` | acetate ion | https://files.wwpdb.org/pub/pdb/refdata/chem_comp/T/ACT/ACT.cif |
| `GLY.cif` | glycine | https://files.wwpdb.org/pub/pdb/refdata/chem_comp/Y/GLY/GLY.cif |
| `ATP.cif` | adenosine 5'-triphosphate | https://files.wwpdb.org/pub/pdb/refdata/chem_comp/P/ATP/ATP.cif |
| `HEM.cif` | protoporphyrin IX containing Fe | https://files.wwpdb.org/pub/pdb/refdata/chem_comp/M/HEM/HEM.cif |
| `STI.cif` | imatinib | https://files.wwpdb.org/pub/pdb/refdata/chem_comp/I/STI/STI.cif |

Fetched on 2026-10-22. The Chemical Component Dictionary is released under
CC0 1.0 (https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/), as the wwPDB
states for the PDB archive's files.
